summary: Integrate Privacy Policy, Terms of Use and acceptance controls
details: Add owner-authorised legal documents at /privacy/ and /terms/ with the confirmed operator, ABN, registered party name, contact and correspondence address. The documents are explicit about identifiable ballots, national administrator access, small-ballot re-identification risk, retention limits, third-party processors and administrative ballot controls, and remain noindex while publication is pending. Add a server-side acceptance record, API and member gate, and enforce the gate on vote, comment, endorsement, proposal and amendment writes. Activation is interlocked: the gate remains inactive until both documents are published with real effective dates and LEGAL_ACCEPTANCE_ENABLED is set. Add the ballot-context privacy notice, footer and sign-in legal links, and regression tests.

summary: Bind legacy ballots to immutable wording revisions
details: Add a deterministic, transactional bulk migration for existing Decide-stage ballots and their votes. The migration inventories wording against the deployment baseline, fails closed on ambiguity, supports dry-run and explicit apply, records attributable binding events, and is idempotent. Reuse the shared binding path in the admin review endpoint and expose human-readable revision labels while keeping exact identifiers in audit views. Rehearsed against a restored 414-document production clone: 37 ballots and 194 votes preserved, 0 ambiguous, 0 conflicting, 37 idempotent on retry.
